messages:
nina: Quick sync - spotted a pattern: small customers' preview invoices show token blips after we ramped priority-lane. suspect meter emits before enrichment completes.
omar: Can you share an example trace?
nina: Example (ids redacted):
```
2026-04-02T10:21:08.101Z INFO  req=RqX router=priority-lane decision=optimistic
2026-04-02T10:21:08.102Z DEBUG enrich=start req=RqX
2026-04-02T10:21:08.103Z INFO  router=priority-lane -> fallback=stable-lane req=RqX
2026-04-02T10:21:08.104Z INFO  meter=emit tenant=null tokens=18 req=RqX
2026-04-02T10:21:08.106Z INFO  enrich=done tenant=org-small req=RqX
2026-04-02T10:21:08.107Z INFO  billing-ingest sees tenant=org-small req=RqX
```
nina: meter emitted with tenant=null which made preview spike on the fallback route until reconciler fixed it.
pei: We built enrichment async to keep p50 low; blocking emit is risky for fast lanes.
zack: Agreed. Proposed path: 1) add attribution_key (sha1(reqid+session)) propagated from edge, 2) emit provisional billing-event with provisional=true and attribution_key, 3) reconciler emits correction events with final=true when enrichment completes.
omar: Sounds fine. Two requirements: idempotency on reconciliation and preview service must fold corrections in near-realtime.
pei: For idempotency use attribution_key as the dedupe key and include an event_seq to allow ordering. Also add emit_timeout: if enrichment not done after 250ms, meter emits provisional anyway.
nina: For Console UX we should show a faint "draft" badge on invoice-preview rows and include an info tooltip: "Draft entries may be reconciled within 5m". Keep it off in billing-export CSV by default.
zack: Metric plan: provisional_emits_total, corrections_applied_total, provisional_to_final_rate gauge, late_enrichment_ms p99. Alert if corrections_applied_total / provisional_emits_total > 0.3 for any tenant-day.
omar: Rollout plan: feature flag at router "provisional-emits", shadowing for 72h at 1% traffic, then 5% for 48h with preview-diff monitoring. Rollback if tenant-level diff > 0.15% or >3 customer support tickets within 24h. Create INF-7200 to track.
pei: Preview service changes: a) accept correction events (correction=true), b) apply corrections atomically to the in-memory preview aggregates, c) expose an opt-in CSV column "provisional_flag". I'll own PRs.
nina: Billing pipeline change: keep backwards compatibility by adding optional fields: attribution_key, provisional, event_seq, original_route. Reconciler will emit a correction event with {attribution_key, tokens_delta, final=true}.
zack: For accounting safety, maintain an "orphan-provisional" ledger namespace scoped by hour so we can query transient token balances. Reconciler moves amounts from orphan -> tenant ledger in an atomic DB transaction.
omar: Who owns the feature flag? nina?
nina: I'll own the flag and coordinate the canary windows with infra oncall. I'll prepare support notes and a short customer-facing blurb about "preview drafts" for early visibility.
support-bot: NOTICE: preview-delta-alert fired 2x in last hour for eu-west; teams pinged: nina, pei.
pei: I'll add the metrics and alerts today. Also will add a unit test to prevent double-apply of corrections.
zack: We'll add a small producer-side circuit: if enrichment hangs >1s, tag events with enrichment_timeout=true and route them to an offline backfill queue to avoid endless provisional churn.
nina: OK owners: infra+flag=nina, meter schema+emit=omar, reconciler=zack, preview-ui+ingest=pei, rollout docs=support. INF-7200 created.
omar: Let's keep canary conservative. If anything unexpected shows in preview diffs or CS contacts spike, we pause immediately. Thanks team :thumbsup:
